blocker.message: The separate profile-to-creator binding is not required under the owner-adjudicated single-owner policy. The existing Post approval endpoint requires a session, but its CRM session shim returns null, so no authenticated operator can currently reach the exact candidate/plan approval path.
evidence: Owner policy: one private operator; explicit approval of one immutable candidate/plan authorizes only that plan; no profile-to-creator ACL requested.
CRM Post For Me routes attach fixed single-tenant operator_id=admin only after INTERNAL_API_KEY middleware.
Post remote main cc8e9c37ddbb06988b6e8330d193356c2d15e08a pages/api/post/like.ts requires getServerSession and validates candidate_id against the exact PublicationPlan snapshot.
Post utils/crm-session.tsx: useSession/getServerSession return null; source comment says CRM identity bridge is not implemented.
CRM /api/v4/auth/me requires bearer JWT; no existing bridge from that identity to Post session was found.
blocker.clearsWhen: Wire the already-existing CRM operator identity into Post's existing getServerSession guard without adding roles, ACLs, ownership tables, Gate-1 scope, or a new auth service; verify the authenticated click is bound to exactly candidate_id + immutable approved snapshot + its one Fansly destination.

disposition.reason: The owner policy resolves the authority decision at single-owner granularity; exact candidate and plan binding already exist. The previous creator-ownership blocker was over-scoped. A distinct existing-session wiring blocker remains and must be proven before private operator actions are available.
disposition.implementation: none; read-only audit and policy adjudication only
